# Problem 1

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
litters_df = janitor::clean_names(penguins)
```

Here is a summary of the penguin dataset 
`r skimr::skim(penguins)`

Variable names include `r names(penguins)`

The size of the penguins dataset includes `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.

The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins,flipper_length_mm)`


Scatterplot of flipper_length_mm (y) vs bill_length_mm (x)
```{r}

ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm,  y = flipper_length_mm, color = species))+geom_point()
ggsave("hw01_scatterplot.png")

```
